summary: Check tests from *.vctest and run them in an emulator or on hardware
description: Searches the path for all *.vctest files and first runs their static checks. With --backend, the entries under "tests" also run: in an emulator (vice, atari800, fujisan, xemu) or on real hardware (u64, m65). Without --backend, these tests appear as skipped.

Build first (vcc build): the runner loads the built program. Test files with "mode": "mailbox" check themselves and are read through the mailbox in RAM. Those with "mode": "measure" measure cycles (on the Ultimate 64 only).
Results per test: OK, FAIL, HINT, TIME (timeout), SKIPPED. A summary is printed at the end.

args.name: folder|file.vctest
args.help: Folder (searched for *.vctest) or a single test file. The default is the working folder.

options.help: Also runs the tests dynamically: vice, atari800 and xemu as emulators, u64 and m65 on real hardware (with address or interface and a safety prompt).
Runs only the dynamic tests that match the text.
Forces the prologue in the trap even with VICE, to check the path of the adapters without flag access (trap mode).
Mailbox tests: reads the mailbox every 100 ms instead of stopping at the endless loop of test_end.
Network password of the Ultimate 64. Otherwise the password of the machine with the same address from the settings.
Answers the safety prompt before a run on hardware with yes. Without a terminal, --yes is required.
Turns every hint into an error.
Also writes the result as JUnit XML.

options.default_text: VC_DATA, otherwise next to the program or in the working folder

examples.title: write the result as JUnit XML

notes: --backend takes vice, atari800, fujisan, xemu (also with the version of a portably installed build, e.g. vice@3.9), u64:HOST[:PORT] or m65:INTERFACE[@BAUD]. Any other value is an error. u64 and m65 without an address are rejected.
atari800 knows only the target atari8, and Xemu only mega65. VICE runs for c64 (x64sc), c128 (x128), plus4 (xplus4) and vic20 (xvic).

On hardware, reset, loading a program and writing memory lose the running state of the device. Only mailbox tests ("mode": "mailbox") and cycle measurements run there. Trap tests are skipped. Cycle measurements need u64:HOST and the debug stream mode 6510 Only on the device.
If no *.vctest is found, the command ends without error.

exit.0: all passed (hints and skipped tests do not count)
exit.1: a test failed, a test file is faulty, or a timeout; also path or data folder not found, invalid --backend, hardware prompt declined
